scenes.title: How to change an OKX referral code
scenes.sub: What you can and can't fix

media.image_prompt: a man sitting at a kitchen table at night, looking at his phone, warm lamp light

lines.show: In general, an OKX referral code is set when you create your account, and it can't simply be edited later in the settings.
If you forgot it, the only reliable answer comes from OKX support inside the app.
Let's look at the mistakes people make, how to ask support, and how to get it right next time.
The most common story: the referral field was marked optional, and it was skipped.
Once registration is complete, the moment to add a code has usually passed.
There are three other mistakes people make.
A typo, so the code linked to nobody.
Signing up on another device without the code.
Or creating the account with a different email than planned.

scenes.title: Don't open a second account
scenes.text: Duplicate accounts can break the rules.

lines.show: Some people try to fix it by opening a second account.
Don't. Exchanges usually restrict duplicate accounts, and it can cause problems with verification.
If you want to ask, do it the safe way.
Open the official OKX app.
Find the Help or Support section.
Start a chat from there.
Ask whether a referral can be added to your account, and accept their answer.

scenes.title: Fake support is everywhere
scenes.text: Only use help inside the app.

lines.show: Never contact support through a phone number or account you found in a comment.
Real support won't ask for your password or your 2FA code.

scenes.title: Open the field first
scenes.text: Before anything else on that screen.

lines.show: If you help a friend sign up, tell them one thing.
Open the referral field first, before typing anything else on that screen.
Then read the code back once before tapping continue.
It takes two seconds and saves a support chat later.

scenes.title: Get it right the first time
scenes.text: Type it before you finish sign-up

lines.show: If you haven't signed up yet, you can use this channel's code: XOACPQFC.
Type it before you finish registration.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live
scenes.text: Type the code when you sign up

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, enter XOACPQFC during sign-up, and check it once before you continue.
Thanks for watching.
